description: This is a Java source file containing an Android instrumentation test class named 'InstrumentedTest'. It includes test methods annotated with @Test, uses Android UI Automator APIs, performs UI automation, element querying, and interaction on an Android device. The file handles socket communication, serializes view information, and executes various UI actions based on received JSON commands.

classes.name: InstrumentedTest
classes.description: This class contains an Android instrumentation test that communicates over a local socket, processes JSON commands to perform UI interactions such as clicks, fills, swipes, and serializes view and accessibility node information.

methods.name: parseSelector
methods.description: Parses a JSON object representing UI element selector criteria and returns a corresponding BySelector object used to query UI elements.

methods.name: parseTimeout
methods.description: Extracts the timeout value from a JSON object, defaults to 30000ms if not specified.

methods.name: parsePoint
methods.description: Creates a Point object from JSON data containing 'x' and 'y' coordinates.

methods.name: parseDirection
methods.description: Converts a JSON string indicating a direction ('up', 'down', 'left', 'right') into the corresponding Direction enum.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a UI element matching criteria to appear within the specified timeout.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets text in a UI element identified by criteria.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Performs a click on a UI element identified by criteria.

methods.name: drag
methods.description: Performs drag operation on a UI element based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: fling
methods.description: Performs fling gesture in a specified direction.

methods.name: longClick
methods.description: Performs a long click on the targeted UI element.

methods.name: pinchClose
methods.description: Performs a pinch close gesture with optional speed.

methods.name: pinchOpen
methods.description: Performs a pinch open gesture with optional speed.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Scrolls in a specified direction by a certain percentage.

methods.name: swipe
methods.description: Performs swipe gesture in a specified direction and distance.

methods.name: serializeRect
methods.description: Serializes a Rect object into JSON with position and size.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a UI element or accessibility node and returns it as JSON.

methods.name: inputPress
methods.description: Simulates a key press event.

methods.name: inputClick
methods.description: Performs a click at specific screen coordinates.

methods.name: inputSwipe
methods.description: Performs a swipe gesture composed of multiple segments.

methods.name: inputDrag
methods.description: Performs a drag from one point to another.

methods.name: tree
methods.description: Serializes the accessibility node tree of the current UI.
